options.notes: Unity JsonUtility, flat: {"dualScreen":1,"touch":"auto"}. Written by the two rows the port adds to Hollow Knight's own Options screens; read once per run (cached), so force-stop before editing. When present it wins over hkds_layout.json for these two settings.

layout.notes: Hand-edited dual-screen runtime config (HKLayout, ~150 flat fields). The app never writes it: it hot-reloads on mtime about 3 times a second, so edits apply live without a restart. Include only the keys you change; unknown keys are ignored (logged once). JsonUtility needs flat name-keyed fields; an empty or half-written file keeps the previous config. stop_before_write is not needed for this file.

tweaks.notes: Mod-menu (QoL/cheat) state, with per-save snapshots. Edit in the bottom-screen mod pane, not here.

dual_screen.label: Options > Game > Dual Screen
